editorial.name: Raster
editorial.descriptionZh: 给团队用的素材管理（DAM），把视觉素材入库、AI 搜索、生成与交付串在一起，还专门做了给 AI agent 取用素材的通道；功能里列了 Reverse Image Search、Handles Video、Edit with AI、Command palette 与 Mac App。
editorial.takeawayZh: 给素材开一个站内 URL，图上线后还能回改内容
editorial.noteZh: 首屏近黑底铺一层点阵，中间一枚带粉点的胶囊写 For humans and agents，大标题 The agent-native DAM for teams that ship.，副标题 Raster gives humans and AI agents one place to store, understand, retrieve, transform, and deliver visual assets.。往下 MISSION 一节写 AI made image creation instant. Asset management hasn't kept up.，再下一句是 Deploy once. Ship forever.——Deploy a unique Raster image URL and edit the image in post, even after it's been shipped.。功能格列了 Live collaboration、Command palette、Reverse Image Search、Handles Video、Edit with AI 和标着 Coming soon 的 Mac App；USE CASES 一节把用法写成大白话：Organize every product photo before a launch、Store AI generations next to final selects。

reasons.statement: 站点是 Raster 这个 DAM 产品的官网，交付的是产品能力说明与注册入口，用户拿走的是产品本身。受控词典里没有素材管理这一类，按产品官网形态归入 product-company-sites——这一点拿不准。
页内 /product、/pricing、/docs、/docs/api 都是产品与开发文档路径，站上没有任何素材或模板可直接下载，证实其为产品官网。
